statements.status_notes: The jackson-databind instances used by neo4j have been bumped to a fixed version. The remaining jackson-databind is shaded and relocated inside parquet-jackson JARs. parquet-jackson only deserializes its own fixed-schema metadata POJOs, which do not rely on @JsonView/@JsonIgnoreProperties filtering, so the property-filtering bypass is not reachable.
